description: APPROX_PERCENTILE(expr, percentile) - the second argument is a constant fraction in [0, 1]. This emulator computes the exact interpolated percentile (the best possible approximation), so results match PERCENTILE_CONT: the median of 1..10 is 5.5, the 0.9 percentile interpolates to 9.1 (index 0.9 * 9 = 8.1, so 9*0.9 + 10*0.1), the extremes return the minimum and maximum, a grouped call answers per group, and an empty input is NULL. Converted 1:1 from functions/ApproxPercentileTest (now retired); its @BeforeEach fixture is inlined per test and the 1e-9 tolerances are supplied by the testkit's numeric normalisation.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE p (grp INTEGER, v DOUBLE)
SELECT APPROX_PERCENTILE(v, 0.5) FROM p WHERE grp = 1
CREATE TABLE p (grp INTEGER, v DOUBLE)
SELECT ABS(APPROX_PERCENTILE(v, 0.9) - 9.1) < 0.000000001 FROM p WHERE grp = 1
CREATE TABLE p (grp INTEGER, v DOUBLE)
SELECT APPROX_PERCENTILE(v, 0.0), APPROX_PERCENTILE(v, 1.0) FROM p WHERE grp = 1
CREATE TABLE p (grp INTEGER, v DOUBLE)
SELECT APPROX_PERCENTILE(v, 0.5) FROM p WHERE grp = 2
